sources.snippet: The layout detection model (DEIMv2) and text recognition model (PARSeq) are both custom-trained and exported to .onnx files that are packaged with the repository under src/model/. The reading order sequencing module (src/ndl_parser.py) is functionally equivalent to the corresponding module in NDLOCR.

sources.snippet: PARSeq Text Recognition Model Relevant source files This page documents the PARSeq-based text recognition component of NDLOCR-Lite: the training pipeline that produces three ONNX model files, and how those files are consumed at runtime by the cascaded recognition stage. For a description of how text recognition fits into the broader OCR pipeline alongside layout detection and reading order ...
